title: Rubrik Announces Protection for Microsoft Azure Cosmos DB
headline: Rubrik announces data protection capabilities for Azure Cosmos DB AI workloads
summary: Rubrik has introduced expanded data protection and cyber resilience capabilities for Microsoft Azure Cosmos DB, securing the data layer behind enterprise AI applications. The solution provides immutable, air-gapped backups, precision container-level recovery, and extended compliance retention outside the native Azure identity boundary. This aims to safeguard mission-critical vector databases and memory stores used by scaling AI workloads against operational disruptions or attacks.
why_it_matters: Organisations scaling AI workloads on cloud databases must ensure robust, independent, air-gapped backup and compliance retention to maintain operational resilience and meet regulatory audit requirements if production environments are compromised.

quotes.text: The expanded Rubrik Cloud Data Protection capabilities protect the data layer behind enterprise AI applications with immutable, application-consistent protection built for scale.
Organisations can enforce SLA-driven retention policies to store data for months or years, which surpasses the native thirty-five day limit to meet the requirements for strict regulatory compliance.

classification.significance_reason: Announces vendor product features for backing up AI data layers, which assists with resilience and compliance but does not alter regulatory obligations.
